rationale: C24 is an unmistakable drafting template for the child. The two orders share nearly verbatim recitals and the same eleven-part sequence governing federal possession of multiple railroad systems, operation through the Secretary of the Army, continued private management, preservation of contracts and labor conditions, regulatory compliance, protection of property and workers, conclusive federal possession, and termination. The child also retains C24's authority to seize additional carriers and its receivership proviso, features absent or narrowed in C15. C15 is a very strong related template but is framed for one railroad. C09 ranks third because its extensive carrier list materially overlaps the child's list, though its emergency-board machinery does not.

shared_material.child_excerpt: as a result of labor disturbances there are interruptions, and threatened interruptions, of the operations of the transportation systems ... it has become necessary to take possession and assume control
shared_material.parent_excerpt: as a result of labor disturbances there are interruptions, and threatened interruptions, of the operations of the transportation systems ... it has become necessary to take possession and assume control
shared_material.explanation: The central factual recital is essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Possession, control, and operation of the transportation systems ... are hereby taken and assumed, through the Secretary of the Army ... If and when the Secretary finds it necessary or appropriate ... [he may] take possession and assume control ... of any other carrier by railroad
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Possession, control, and operation of the transportation systems ... are hereby taken and assumed, through the Secretary of the Army ... If and when the Secretary finds it necessary or appropriate ... [he may] take possession and assume control ... of any other carrier by railroad
shared_material.explanation: The principal seizure mechanism and expandable scope are reproduced with only dates and minor wording changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary shall permit the management of carriers ... to continue their respective managerial functions to the maximum degree possible ... existing contracts and agreements ... shall remain in full force and effect.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary shall permit the management of carriers ... to continue their respective managerial functions to the maximum degree possible ... existing contracts and agreements ... shall remain in full force and effect.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the same private-management and contract-preservation machinery in the same operative sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Except with the prior written consent of the Secretary, no receivership, reorganization, or similar proceeding ... shall be instituted ... provided that nothing herein shall prevent or require approval ... of any ... decree of any United States court in reorganization proceedings now pending
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Except with the prior written consent of the Secretary, no receivership, reorganization, or similar proceeding ... shall be instituted ... provided that nothing herein shall prevent or require approval ... of any ... decree of any United States court in reorganization proceedings now pending
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive and detailed receivership restriction and pending-case proviso are carried over nearly word for word.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Possession, control, and operation of any transportation system ... shall be terminated by the Secretary when he determines that such possession, control, and operation are no longer necessary
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Possession, control, and operation of any transportation system ... shall be terminated by the Secretary when he determines that such possession, control, and operation are no longer necessary
shared_material.explanation: The final termination provision completes the same eleven-section administrative architecture.
